references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God to Moses to make a border around the table that is a handbreadth wide, with a gold crown around the border. Exodus 37:12 describes the fulfillment of this instruction.
The verse mentions the gold crown that was to be made around the table, which is the same decorative element described in Exodus 37:12.
These verses describe the beginning of the construction of the table for the bread of the Presence, of which the border and gold crown in verse 12 are a part.
The altar of incense also had a gold crown around it, showing the same decorative pattern used on the tabernacle's furniture.
The gold crown on the altar of incense parallels the gold crown on the table's border, demonstrating consistent design in the holy objects of the tabernacle.
